name: PKCS#12 Password Changer
description: Change the passphrase of a PKCS#12 container while keeping its content intact.

examples.label: Change the test container to a new passphrase

hints.toolbit: Only containers **packed by this tool** can be re-keyed: containers from other implementations are rejected (registered upstream gap).
hints.both: Both passphrases are required: without the current one the container cannot be opened, without the new one it cannot be re-encrypted.
hints.output: The output is a **new container**; replace the old file. The old container still opens with the old passphrase.

faq.q: Does changing the passphrase regenerate the key?
faq.a: No. The certificate and private key are kept as is; only the encryption passphrase changes.

faq.q: Why do some containers refuse to change?
faq.a: The upstream re-keying implementation only handles certain container layouts; containers produced by other tools are rejected.

faq.q: What happens if the old passphrase is wrong?
faq.a: It reports "passphrase incorrect" and the container is untouched.
